models.label: Real age
models.question: How old this person actually is
models.explanation: Trained on about 300,000 photos with real chronological ages (AgeDB, APPA-REAL, FG-NET, IMDB-Clean), tuned for ages 14 to 60. Typical error about 6.2 years against a person's actual age.

checkpoint.real_age_corpus: AgeDB + APPA-REAL + FG-NET held-out test, n=3818
checkpoint.accuracy_note: real_age_mae is the error against real chronological age on the clean-label held-out split, measured through the ml crop path (the same YuNet crop at margin 0.0) rather than end to end through this server. This model never saw UTKFace.

interval_calibration.corpus: AgeDB + APPA-REAL + FG-NET held-out test, n=3818
interval_calibration.note: The low/high interval is nominally 68% (the 0.16/0.84 quantiles) and covers about 71% on this corpus. The previous model covered 61% on the same split. Not retuned, because tuning it to the split it is measured on would be fitting the evaluation set.
